structured_extraction.agency: Washington County Department of Business and Economic Development (DBED)
structured_extraction.assistance_description: The program provides a tax credit on the County portion of real estate taxes for up to 15 years. The length and amount of the credit depend on how much the business invests and how many jobs it creates.
structured_extraction.application_deadline_string: You must submit applications and letters of intent before you occupy the space or hire new employees. You must also submit annual reports by February 1st.
structured_extraction.program_audience: For-profit businesses that expand or move into Washington County.
structured_extraction.use_of_funds: Property tax relief on the increased assessed value of new, renovated, or expanded business premises.

requirements_list: You must submit a Letter of Intent before you occupy the space or hire new employees.
For Tier 1: Use at least 1,500 square feet and create 5 new full-time jobs within 12 months.
For Tier 2: Use at least 2,500 square feet and create 25 new full-time jobs within 24 months.
For Tier 3: Invest $20 million and create 200 new full-time jobs within 24 months.
For Tier 3: Pay 80% of new employees at least 200% of the Maryland State minimum wage.
You must file annual employment and certification reports by February 1st each year.
structured_extraction.application_process_overview: 1. Submit a Letter of Intent and the application to the DBED before starting construction or moving in. 2. The DBED reviews and certifies your application. 3. Notify the DBED when you finish construction. 4. Create the required number of full-time jobs within the 12 to 24-month window. 5. Submit your annual report every year to stay certified for the credit.
